We then annotate the sentences of the generated passages using the guidelines shown in Figure such that each sentence is classified as either: • Major Inaccurate (Non-Factual, 1): The sentence is entirely hallucinated, i.e. the sentence is unrelated to the topic. • Minor Inaccurate (Non-Factual, 0.5): The sentence consists of some non-factual information, but the sentence is related to the topic. • Accurate (Factual, 0): The information presented in the sentence is accurate.
guideline: Sentences are annotated based on factuality into categories: Major Inaccurate, Minor Inaccurate, or Accurate.
